description: This file defines the BlobReporter class, a test report generator that creates ZIP reports with metadata, attachments, and test results, used within the Playwright testing framework.

classes.name: BlobReporter
classes.description: A class that generates ZIP reports for Playwright test results, including metadata, attachments, and logs, extending TeleReporterEmitter.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes BlobReporter with options, validates filename extension, and generates a GUID salt.

methods.name: onConfigure
methods.description: Sets up report metadata including version, user agent, and shard info, then calls superclass method.

methods.name: onTestPaused
methods.description: No-op method for handling test pause events, relevant only for interactive use.

methods.name: onEnd
methods.description: Finalizes the report by creating a ZIP file with metadata, attachments, and test results.

methods.name: _prepareOutputFile
methods.description: Determines output file path, cleans previous reports unless prevented, and creates necessary directories.

methods.name: _defaultReportName
methods.description: Generates default report filename based on command hash and shard info.

methods.name: _serializeAttachments
methods.description: Serializes test attachments, computes SHA1 hashes for resource naming, and tracks attachments for ZIP inclusion.
